Vendored, unmodified prebuilt Koffi 3.1.1 (MIT, https://koffi.dev) for Windows x64, the same version DeepSeek Orb 0.1.7
shipped. It is vendored so installing dsh-orb runs no build scripts (DSH profiles ignore dependency build scripts).
Docs, C sources and the import library were dropped; see koffi/LICENSE.txt.
